subject: RFI response comparison & onboarding asks — annual external testing
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: RFI responses consolidated + quick ask

Hi all,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the RFI. I pulled the three vendor responses into a single matrix (attached) — RedTest, Pentra, and one boutique firm that opted out of a full SOW for now. High level notes in the sheet, but the items I want us to confirm this week:

- Technical fit: Karthik, please call out any blockers from the RedTest and Pentra answers (esp. in-scope backend access, test windows, and storage/retention for logs).
- Commercial: Marissa, can you confirm if we have budget runway for the higher-priced Pentra quote or if we should push for additional discounts?
- Legal/contracting: Laura, the RedTest SOW has the standard redlines but a few items around data handling we should tighten.

Attachments: rfi_matrix.xlsx (matrix + scoring), redtest_sow_v1.pdf, pentra_quote_20270508.pdf

Goal: pick preferred vendor and agree onboarding checklist by EOD Fri 5/7 so procurement can get PO out.

Thanks — Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Senior Manager, Growth & GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T13:05:00Z
Subject: Re: RFI responses consolidated + quick ask

Neha,

Quick technical read — thanks for assembling. Short summary:

- RedTest: methodology looks solid. Concern: they require a short-lived service account with elevated read-only DB access to run credentialed tests. We should scope the exact schema/tables they need and insist on a jumpbox with session recording. Also confirm they will rotate creds each engagement.
- Pentra: offers hybrid authenticated + unauthenticated testing and provides an optional containerized agent for endpoint-only access (nice for private infra). Their timeline is longer (10 business days vs. RedTest 6 business days).
- Boutique: too manual; won't scale and no evidence of prior SaaS infra tests.

For onboarding asks, propose these must-haves:
1) Temporary service account created with least privilege + audit log retention (90 days)
2) Clear scope doc with allowlist/denylist before test start
3) Written confirmation of no persistent credentials stored post-test
4) Evidence of SOC2 or similar, and proof of PI handling controls

I can draft a technical annex to the SOW that enumerates required access patterns. If we prefer faster time-to-test, RedTest is fine, but we should harden the access controls in the SOW.

Karthik
Principal Security Engineer
From: Claire Ramos <claire@redtestsec.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@redtestsec.com
Date: 2027-05-06T11:22:00Z
Subject: Re: RFI — clarifications and onboarding timeline

Hi Neha,

Thanks for sharing the matrix. A few clarifications from our side and proposed next steps:

- Service account: we confirm we only request a short-lived, scoped service account. We rotate creds daily during the engagement and delete them after final report delivery. We can use a jumpbox and feed sessions into an S3 bucket controlled by your team.
- Evidence: attached is our redtest_sow_v1.pdf (same as you have) and a link to our SOC2 Type II report excerpt.
- Timeline: we can start as early as 05/10 if PO is issued by 05/08. Typical engagement: 5 business days of active testing + 2 days for reporting.

A few questions for Karthik: do you have a preferred jumpbox configuration (OS/version) or should we provide a hardened AMI? Also, any IP allowlist you want us to use for the short window?

If you confirm PO timing, procurement@redtestsec.com will issue a standard commercial invoice and accept Net30.

Best,
Claire Ramos
Director, Client Success
RedTest Security

[Attachment: redtest_sow_v1.pdf]
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-07T09:40:00Z
Subject: Re: RFI responses consolidated + quick ask

Team,

I reviewed RedTest's SOW. A couple of legal redlines to add before PO:

- Data handling: require explicit clause that raw test output containing PII must be delivered only over our secure upload (no vendor-managed cloud buckets without prior approval).
- Indemnity: narrow to breaches caused by vendor negligence; remove overly broad language around third-party downstream claims.
- IP: confirm that findings belong to Redwood and vendor retains no rights to source data.

Also recommend we add an acceptance criteria milestone tied to final report delivery before final 10% payment is released. Procurement, if we authorize Net30, please add the PO reference into the SOW header.

I'll mark the PDF and send redlines as comments by EOD.

Laura
Senior Counsel, Legal Ops
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Claire Ramos <claire@redtestsec.com>, procurement@redtestsec.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: RFI responses consolidated + quick ask — decision & next steps

Claire / RedTest procurement,

Thanks for the quick responses and for confirming timelines. We ran through technical, commercial, and legal feedback internally and want to move forward with RedTest on a trial engagement with the following conditions:

1) PO issued by Redwood procurement to match redtest_sow_v1.pdf with Laura's redlines incorporated (I will send the tracked changes).
2) Temporary service account + jumpbox as discussed; Karthik will send the AMI config and allowlist by 05/10 morning.
3) Start date target: 05/12 (pending PO).
4) Payment terms: Net30 accepted; final 10% to be held until acceptance criteria milestone (per Laura).

Marissa — please raise the PO once you receive the final SOW with redlines. Karthik/Laura — share the annex and redlines; Claire/procurement@redtestsec.com — confirm receipt and that PO timeline is feasible.

Attachments referenced in thread: rfi_matrix.xlsx, redtest_sow_v1.pdf, pentra_quote_20270508.pdf
